metadata.name: battlechan
metadata.description: BattleChan - time-boxed, token-curated social boards on Solana

accounts.name: victim
docs: The post currently in the slot being overwritten (None while the ring is still filling).

accounts.name: recipient_ata
docs: Required for kind 1 (treasury spend): the recipient's $TIME token account.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Holds all $TIME paid into post pots.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: DAO treasury: receives 50% of downvote $TIME, funds staking rewards.

accounts.name: faucet_pool
docs: Airdrop / incentive pool that backs the testnet faucet.

accounts.name: karma_mint
docs: $KARMA: a real SPL token. Only this program (via the config PDA) can mint it, up to the 1T cap.

accounts.name: karma_vault
docs: Escrow for staked $KARMA (auto-stake on earn).

accounts.name: karma_treasury_ta
docs: DAO's $KARMA treasury: spent karma (bombs / resurrections) returns here.

accounts.name: victim
docs: The live post currently in the ring slot that the resurrected post will take.

accounts.name: referrer_profile
docs: Required (and checked) when the comment author was referred by someone.

errors.name: WrongVictim
errors.msg: Wrong victim account for the category slot being bumped

errors.name: ZeroVotes
errors.msg: Vote count must be greater than zero

errors.name: SelfVote
errors.msg: Cannot vote on your own comment

errors.name: TooEarly
errors.msg: Initial visibility period has not ended

errors.name: NotEligible
errors.msg: Comment is not eligible for rewards

errors.name: NeedDailyComment
errors.msg: Staking rewards require a comment within the last 24h

fields.name: slots
docs: Ring buffer of the 20 live posts. Pubkey::default() = empty slot.

fields.name: karma_vault
docs: Escrow holding every staked $KARMA token.

fields.name: karma_treasury_ta
docs: DAO $KARMA treasury: spent karma lands here.

fields.name: karma_minted
docs: Total $KARMA ever minted (base units).

fields.name: karma_treasury
docs: Total spent $KARMA returned to the DAO (base units, accounting).

fields.name: vote_cost
docs: $TIME (base units) per single up/down vote.

fields.name: bomb_time_burn
docs: $TIME (base units) burned out of the DAO treasury per karma bomb.

fields.name: withdraw_penalty_secs
docs: Seconds knocked off a post per vote-worth of $TIME the owner withdraws.

fields.name: owner
docs: Current owner (NFT-lite: can be traded; owner receives the 75% pot).

fields.name: pot
docs: Total $TIME (base units) paid into this post by upvotes.

fields.name: reports
docs: Number of wallets that reported this post to the admin for review.

fields.name: kind
docs: 0 = parameter change, 1 = treasury spend

fields.name: karma
docs: Staked $KARMA in base units (auto-staked; the tokens sit in the karma vault).
